title: Storybound phrases
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/phrases/<path>.json — an NPC's short lines, one at a time, without a conversation: its chatter, what it says on a click or when hit. Only texts: a dialogue is started by the NPC itself (a click entry's or when_attacked's dialogue).

order.description: random: one at random, never the same twice in a row. sequence: top to bottom, then the last one again (lines that build up: "Careful!", "Last warning!"). loop: top to bottom, then from the top again (chatter going round).

lines.description: Each line is a text said in a bubble over the NPC.
